profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, USA, trading under the ticker IBM. Its most recent annual filing, a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reported revenue of $67,535,000,000. IBM's OpenPages site describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform that is modular and available on any cloud or on-premises, so organizations can deploy only the components they need. The site states that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment.

IBM's AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, described as a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules for risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation, and IBM watsonx.governance, which covers AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators. IBM watsonx.governance is noted as a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant, dated June 2026. IBM watsonx is described as an enterprise AI platform that is model-agnostic. The site says OpenPages can connect to watsonx.ai or third-party and custom models through an API-based architecture, and it describes an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query, and update GRC objects. The site also cites a partnership with Citi to automate internal audit using AI and machine learning.

Litigation records list 448 cases in New York.
